text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Haa~...
Haa...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah...!
Man, I'm so frustrated right now...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City-san...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Still... that was fun.
*Sigh*..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Racing really is...
great.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Running feels so good.
Becoming one with the wind,
forgetting about everything else..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There's just me, running.
Nothing else matters, just that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I wonder why. Just that alone makes me so, so happy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I... like myself the most
when I'm running.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Me too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I love seeing you run, City-san.
And that's why...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The me right now
is the one I love the most!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Yukino.
—Have a safe journey!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes...!
(Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Yukino Bijin...!
You were so amazingly cool...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Yukinooo!
You're the best Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Yukino! Yukino! Yukino!
Yukino! Yukino! Yukino!
Yukino! Yukino! Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

Cheers and applause showered down upon Yukino Bijin.
Spontaneously erupting, they swallowed all other sounds like falling snow—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —That's freakin' amazin'.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

The cheers echoing across the turf
showed no sign of stopping for quite a while...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if I've gotten a little closer
to being a true 'City Girl.'"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank ye kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, this ain't the end! A real boom is way bigger than this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, we gotta keep bustin' our tails and workin' hard.
Right?
choice_data_list: I'll stick with you all the way.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
I look forward to working with you!
(Vroom...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
From Mifuyu-chan...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wah!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu-chan,
I heard you passed your badge test...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
With this, we've taken a step...
toward the world championship, toward making our dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, who knew something like this could happen?
For both of us to get closer to our dreams together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"What happened today... I...
There's no way I'll ever forget it!"
